lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee dhoor naanak daas baachhai jin har naam ridai paroee ||2||5||33||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of those, who have woven the Lord's Name into their hearts. ||2||5||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੂਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke dookh nivaarai sookaa man saadhaarai ||
lines.translation: He dispels the pains of countless incarnations, and lends support to the dry and shrivelled mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: darasan bhetat hot nihaalaa har kaa naam beechaarai ||1||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is enraptured, contemplating the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa baid guroo govi(n)daa ||
lines.translation: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam aukhadh mukh devai kaatai jam kee pha(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He places the medicine of the Naam into my mouth, and cuts away the noose of Death. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: samarath purakh pooran bidhaate aape karanaihaaraa ||
lines.translation: He is the all-powerful, Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: apunaa daas har aap ubaariaa naanak naam adhaaraa ||2||6||34||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself saves His slave; Nanak takes the Support of the Naam. ||2||6||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar kee gat tum hee jaanee tujh hee paahi nibero ||
lines.translation: Only You know the state of my innermost self; You alone can judge me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਲਾਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bakhas laihu saahib prabh apane laakh khate kar phero ||1||
lines.translation: Please forgive me, O Lord God Master; I have committed thousands of sins and mistakes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh jee too mero thaakur nero ||
lines.translation: O my Dear Lord God Master, You are always near me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਮੋਹਿ ਚੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har charan saran mohi chero ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, please bless Your disciple with the shelter of Your feet. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚੋ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee oocho gunee gahero ||
lines.translation: Infinite and endless is my Lord and Master; He is lofty, virtuous and profoundly deep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: kaat silak keeno apuno daasaro tau naanak kahaa nihoro ||2||7||35||
lines.translation: Cutting away the noose of death, the Lord has made Nanak His slave, and now, what does he owe to anyone else? ||2||7||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal guroo govi(n)daa sagal manorath paae ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: asathir bhae laag har charanee govi(n)d ke gun gaae ||1||
lines.translation: I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhalo samoorat pooraa ||
lines.translation: It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t sahaj aana(n)d naam jap vaaje anahad tooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mile suaamee preetam apune ghar ma(n)dar sukhadaaee ||
lines.translation: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filled with happiness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: har naam nidhaan naanak jan paaiaa sagalee ichh pujaaee ||2||8||36||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have been fulfilled. ||2||8||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਲਖਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan base rid bheetar subh lakhan prabh keene ||
lines.translation: The Guru's feet abide within my heart; God has blessed me with good fortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal pooran paramesar naam nidhaan man cheene ||1||
lines.translation: The Perfect Transcendent Lord became merciful to me, and I found the treasure of the Naam within my mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: mero gur rakhavaaro meet ||
lines.translation: My Guru is my Saving Grace, my only best friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਣ ਚਊਣੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: doon chaoonee de vadiaaee sobhaa neetaa neet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Over and over again, He blesses me with double, even four-fold, greatness. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t prabh sagal udhaare darasan dekhanahaare ||
lines.translation: God saves all beings and creatures, giving them the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore kee acharaj vadiaaee naanak sad balihaare ||2||9||37||
lines.translation: Wondrous is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||37||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਤੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)chan karau naam dhan niramal thaatee agam apaar ||
lines.translation: I gather in and collect the immaculate wealth of the Naam; this commodity is inaccessible and incomparable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਛਿ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bilachh binod aana(n)d sukh maanahu khaai jeevahu sikh paravaar ||1||
lines.translation: Revel in it, delight in it, be happy and enjoy peace, and live long, O Sikhs and brethren. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke charan kamal aadhaar ||
lines.translation: I have the support of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad paaio sach bohith chaR la(n)ghau bikh sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found the boat of Truth; embarking on it, I sail across the ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal pooran abinaasee aapahi keenee saar ||
lines.translation: The perfect, imperishable Lord has become merciful; He Himself has taken care of me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano naanak naahee sumaar ||2||10||38||
lines.translation: Beholding, beholding His Vision, Nanak has blossomed forth in ecstasy. O Nanak, He is beyond estimation. ||2||10||38||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai apanee kal dhaaree sabh ghat upajee daiaa ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has revealed His power, and compassion has welled up in every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਨੀ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel vadaaee keenee kusal khem sabh bhaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Blending me with Himself, He has blessed me with glorious greatness, and I have found pleasure and happiness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur pooraa merai naal ||
lines.translation: The Perfect True Guru is always with me.
